name: Brookfield
coverage: Selected India operating platforms, a sponsored REIT and listed portfolio companies across telecom towers, offices, hospitality, data centres and renewable power.
limitations: Selective public-disclosure coverage, not a complete portfolio or a live ownership register. The review date does not update the date of an older holding disclosure.
Ownership belongs to the named entity, fund, subsidiary or platform. Fund commitments, acquisitions of assets and joint-venture stakes are not holdings in the listed parent.
Announced investments remain proposed unless closing evidence was reviewed. An unavailable percentage is not zero.
Investment themes and business cases are research interpretations of the cited activity, not forecasts or recommendations.

altius-2024.title: Brookfield-led consortium completes ATC India acquisition

altius-2026.title: Latham advises La Caisse on completed Altius investment
altius-2026.note: Transaction adviser states completion and identifies Brookfield as the largest investor, without providing its retained percentage.

evren.title: Axis Energy: joint-venture history
evren.note: Partner describes the 51:49 Brookfield/Axis JV split; this is not a Brookfield Corporation shareholder stake.

companies.name: Altius telecom infrastructure platform
companies.relationship: Brookfield-sponsored Data Infrastructure Trust combined its Indian tower businesses under Altius.
companies.ownership: Largest investor after September transaction; percentage not disclosed
companies.summary: The adviser confirms Brookfield remains the largest investor after La Caisse’s entry. The disclosed 24% transaction stake is not assigned to Brookfield.
companies.thesis: Research interpretation: tower networks offer infrastructure exposure to mobile-data demand.
companies.risks: Tenant concentration, financing and telecom-sector economics.

companies.name: Brookfield India Real Estate Trust
companies.relationship: A Brookfield Asset Management affiliate sponsors the REIT.
companies.ownership: Sponsor relationship; current unit holding not verified
companies.summary: The listed trust provides office-property exposure. Sponsorship is distinct from owning all trust units.
companies.thesis: Research interpretation: office demand and active asset management can support income growth.
companies.risks: Occupancy, interest rates, leverage and related-party acquisitions.

companies.name: CleanMax
companies.relationship: Brookfield Renewable’s annual filing identifies CleanMax in its Indian portfolio and discusses its February 2026 IPO.
companies.ownership: Platform relationship; post-IPO percentage not verified
companies.ownershipDate: FY2025 annual filing; February 2026 IPO update
companies.summary: The record identifies portfolio exposure without assuming the current retained stake after listing.
companies.thesis: Research interpretation: corporate clean-energy demand may support operating and development assets.
companies.risks: Project delivery, offtaker credit, dilution and valuation.

companies.name: Digital Connexion
companies.relationship: Joint venture between Brookfield, Reliance Industries and Digital Realty.
companies.ownership: JV partner; percentage not stated on reviewed page
companies.summary: The company confirms all three partners. No equal ownership split or stake in Reliance Industries is assumed.
companies.thesis: Research interpretation: connectivity and cloud adoption can support data-centre demand.
companies.risks: Power availability, lease execution, capital intensity and competition.

companies.name: Evren / Axis clean-energy joint venture
companies.relationship: Axis Energy describes the Brookfield/Axis JV ownership split as 51:49.
companies.ownership: 51% Brookfield side of JV, per partner disclosure
companies.ownershipDate: JV history on partner page reviewed 23 Oct 2026
companies.summary: The percentage belongs to the joint-venture structure, not to ownership of Axis Energy or listed Brookfield entities.
companies.thesis: Research interpretation: a development platform can address utility and industrial clean-power demand.
companies.risks: Construction, permits, offtake and development capital.

companies.name: The Leela / Schloss Bangalore
companies.relationship: Brookfield acquired the hotel platform in 2019 and identifies its June 2025 IPO.
companies.ownership: Brookfield-backed platform; current listed stake not verified
companies.summary: The investment history and listing are documented. A post-IPO shareholder percentage was not reconciled.
companies.thesis: Research interpretation: luxury hospitality offers exposure to travel demand and asset management.
companies.risks: Travel cyclicality, capital spending and listed valuation.

events.title: Adviser confirms Altius transaction completion
events.detail: La Caisse invested alongside Brookfield; the adviser states Brookfield remained the platform’s largest investor.
events.qualification: The 24% transaction figure is not Brookfield’s retained percentage; no increase or reduction in its own stake is inferred.

report.title: Brookfield in India
report.summary: Brookfield’s Indian exposure is spread across operating platforms, institutional partnerships and listed vehicles. The six reviewed records retain their investment level rather than assigning every platform percentage to the parent company.

sections.title: Real-asset approach
sections.text: Brookfield describes acquiring quality assets and improving them through active management. This provides a framework for reviewing its office and hospitality relationships.

sections.title: Digital infrastructure
sections.text: Altius and Digital Connexion are separate tower and data-centre platforms. Their co-investors and legal ownership structures matter to interpreting the exposure.

sections.title: Energy transition
sections.text: Evren and CleanMax are identified in renewable-platform disclosures. JV ownership and post-IPO ownership are different measures.

themes.name: Digital infrastructure
themes.case: Research interpretation: towers and data centres connect investment activity to communication and cloud demand.
themes.watch: Capital intensity, tenant quality and power availability.

themes.name: Property and clean power
themes.case: Research interpretation: offices, hospitality and renewables provide different long-duration operating exposures.
themes.watch: Asset-level leverage, execution and demand cycles.
